kaikki_vikisozluk.e: صَعْلَكَ • (ṣaʕlaka) Iq (non-past يُصَعْلِكُ (yuṣaʕliku), verbal noun صَعْلَكَة (ṣaʕlaka))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Denominative quadriliteral verb from صُعْلُوك (ṣuʕlūk, “pauper, indigent; brigand”), itself of uncertain derivation; the noun is attested well before the verb and the lexicographers treat صعلك as secondary to it. Compare the semantically parallel تَمَسْكَنَ (tamaskana) from مِسْكِين (miskīn).
g: to impoverish, to reduce to penury, to render destitute
to heap up the ṯarīd into a peak, to raise the head of (a mess of crumbled bread)
to round and stretch up the lower part of (a camel's hump)
